title: Block Predicate
description: A BlockRule is a predicate (test) applied to a block. The 'predicate_type' determines the test and what other fields are valid.

choices.title: Always True
choices.description: The test is skipped and assumed true. Default predicate if none specified.

choices.title: Block Match
choices.description: Matches if the block is exactly the given block name. Requires 'block'.

choices.title: Random Block Match
choices.description: Matches if the block equals 'block' AND a random roll passes 'probability' (0-1). Use minecraft:block_match if it should always match.

choices.title: Blockstate Match
choices.description: Matches if the block matches the given BlockSpecifier (name + states). Requires 'block_state'.

choices.title: Random Blockstate Match
choices.description: Matches if the block matches the BlockSpecifier AND a random roll passes 'probability' (0-1). Requires 'block_state' and 'probability'.

choices.title: Tag Match
choices.description: Matches if the block carries the given block tag. Requires 'tag'.

fields.title: Block
fields.description: Block identifier to match. Used by 'block_match' and 'random_block_match'.

fields.title: Block State
fields.description: BlockSpecifier to match (name plus optional states). Used by 'blockstate_match' and 'random_blockstate_match'.

fields.title: Tag
fields.description: Block tag to match. Used by 'tag_match'.

fields.title: Probability
fields.description: Probability of matching, in the range [0, 1]. Used by 'random_block_match' and 'random_blockstate_match'.
